name: labs/vadter__hantek6022be
title: Hantek 6022BE USB oscilloscope (pyhantek6022BE.Hantek)
intro: Hantek 6022BE USB oscilloscope (pyhantek6022BE.Hantek), adapted from vadter/hantek6022be. It reads `acquisition`; sets `sample_rate`, `ch1_vdiv` and `ch2_vdiv`. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/vadter__hantek6022be --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/vadter__hantek6022be --backend fake --mcp
